steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Market segmentation divides the market into groups with similar characteristics: demographic (age, gender, income), geographic (location), psychographic (lifestyle, values), and behavioural (purchasing habits, brand loyalty). | Key Fact: Primary research collects new data directly: surveys, focus groups, interviews, observations. It's specific to the business but expensive and time-consuming. | Key Fact: Secondary research uses existing data: government statistics, trade reports, competitor accounts, internet research. It's cheaper and faster but may be outdated or not specific to the business's needs. | Key Fact: Quantitative data is numerical and statistical (percentages, averages, charts); qualitative data is descriptive (opinions, feelings, reasons behind choices).
